# checksum_algo_version: 19
# Pins the SimChecksum (v8) sequence for AntiBuildingScenario.Build() (a melee + a ranged Siege unit ordered onto a Neutral building via CommandState=AttackBuilding; the ranged unit chases + fires real projectiles; Player2 empty so the AI no-ops) stepped via StepOnce at ChecksumInterval=1.
